# Formula grid answers from Excel

Generated by `tools/FormulaGrid gen` (the `*.fgrid` inputs: one test per line, id, entry form, formula text). Excel 16.0 build 20527 entered each
formula with `Formula2` / `Formula2R1C1` / `Formula2Local` and recalculated; the answers are the `*.fgrid.tsv` files (entered text, R1C1 and local
forms, spill shape, values). `FormulaGrid compare <inputs> <answers>` evaluates and prints the same formulas with OneOffice and lists every
disagreement; `mismatches.txt` is that list for these files. Each remaining entry is explained in `docs/calc.md` (Excel rejects the text at entry;
`^` differs from Excel's power routine in the 14th digit).
